g.text: MinVelRank5Convo1 begins.
Check boolean MinVelTogether
MomToxicated: I can't help but wonder what Neci would think if she knew we were stuck here.
true
MomToxicated: I can't help but wonder what Neci would think if she knew we were stuck here.
false
PapaPolar: i hope she'd be happy to see we'd settled our issues.
PapaPolar: probably come back just to put us out of our misery.
Yeah... who knows. [End.]
Did she know you two had fallen apart?
MomToxicated: Wouldn't blame her.
+20 Chemistry
MomToxicated: She was perceptive. More than most. More than we'd trained her to be.
+20 Chemistry
Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank5Convo2.
PapaPolar: the last time we spoke to her was on a secure line.
Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank5Convo2.
PapaPolar: and that weird lookin' little grease weasel of hers was probably listening in
PapaPolar: at that point we were still *technically* together, but things were going south, fast...
MomToxicated: I'd bet good money she knew. She could hear it. Even if we didn't know it at the time.
Could you tell if she was... y'know. "Him" yet?
What did you three talk about?
PapaPolar: she sounded like our little girl, if that's what you're asking. knew what to say and how to say it.
MomToxicated: It started off business. How she was handling command. She couldn't give us numbers, or details, of course.
MomToxicated: But all good hostage takers know how to make their captive birds sing on command.
MomToxicated: We weren't Scaldra. Nothing more than civvies, to the people on the other end of the line. So she couldn't be giving us classified intel.
MomToxicated: That doesn't mean anything about when, or how, this "Indifference" took her.
PapaPolar: but she sounded... stressed. you could hear it.
MomToxicated: Or who was driving her body when we spoke to her that day.
Her? Stressed? Hard to imagine.
Stressed about what?
PapaPolar: i don't know how one finds a god and punches it in the [REDACTED] face but i'm gonna [REDACTED] try
MomToxicated: Heh. Happens to the best of us. Especially when you're chasing a "fugitive."
MomToxicated: A "fugitive."
MomToxicated: Entrati. At the time, I figured it was "just" a local drug lord or resistance leader.
PapaPolar: barely even mentioned the freakin' monster toaster tv zombies. you'd think that would've come up more.
MomToxicated: I wonder if she had lost her arm yet at that point. No way to know, I suppose.
How'd you end things?
Did you tell her you were coming to Höllvania?
MomToxicated: The way spies always end phone calls. By lying to each other.
PapaPolar: lol. hells no. city was under lockdown, remember? total covert ops, us sneaking in.
MomToxicated: We told her we'd be going on a mission somewhere else, when we were planning on deploying into her locked-down city.
MomToxicated: We ended the call the way spies always end phone calls. By lying.
PapaPolar: and then we both told each other the biggest lie of all.
PapaPolar: we all said "don't worry, we'll be fine."
MomToxicated: At least we did tell her one last truthful thing before we hung up.
PapaPolar: yeah. we did.
Oh?
Which was?
PapaPolar: "You're our baby girl. And nothing will ever change that."
MomToxicated: "We'll always love you, no matter how far away you go."
I'm sure she still knows that, no matter what's really happened to her.
She was lucky to have you both as parents.
+10 Chemistry
PapaPolar: thanks.
+10 Chemistry
MomToxicated: I hope you're right.
Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank5Convo2.
